resources.string: Prefer subtitles: use the video subtitle track and its timing, then try matching lyrics if unavailable. Subtitles may require signing in. Text embedded in the video image cannot be read.\nPrefer matched lyrics (default): keep matching lyrics on other platforms by title, artist and similar duration, then try video subtitles if no match is found. Applies to playback and lyric downloads. Manually imported lyrics take priority.
Scan a QR code or enter SESSDATA. Credentials are encrypted on this device.

Signing in on multiple devices
One account can be signed in on multiple devices. Limits on staying signed in differ from limits on simultaneous playback of membership content. Playback allowances are not login device limits.

Premium membership (大会员)
Up to 2 devices can use membership services simultaneously. On phones, up to 2 devices can use membership services within 24 hours.

Super Premium membership (超级大会员)
Up to 4 devices can play membership content simultaneously. Within 24 hours, up to 2 phones and 2 TVs can use these services. Some continuously active older memberships follow earlier rules; see the official agreement.

Using this app
Your phone and tablet can sign in to the same account separately by QR code, with credentials stored on each device. This app adds no device limit. No uniform public device allowance was found for simultaneous playback or download of ordinary Bilibili video audio; availability depends on Bilibili’s actual limits.

Rules may change. Refer to Bilibili’s latest official agreements.

Sign in on the official Bilibili website and copy the SESSDATA cookie value. No password or full cookie string is needed. Credentials are encrypted on this device and are never given to custom scripts. Replace expired credentials here.

Download the original audio and encode it as MP3 at 320 kbps. Conversion cannot improve source quality. Lyrics are matched by title, artist and duration; unmatched lyrics do not affect the audio. Only the first part of multi-part videos is used.
